high_level_description: The image shows a set of four square tiles with a consistent pattern laid out on a concrete surface. The tiles feature an intricate design consisting of repeating white arches and curves against a deep blue background. The pattern is symmetrical and geometric, creating a visually striking contrast between the two colors. The tiles are arranged in a 2x2 grid, with each tile touching the others at their edges. The concrete surface beneath the tiles has a rough texture, with some areas appearing slightly worn or stained, adding to the industrial feel of the setting.
